hypothesis: The two-CCK early completion observation depends on CPU BBUSY polling/grant cadence.
competitor: Blitter terminal sequencing is early independently of poll cadence.
test: Sweep zero to three ROM NOPs before each BBUSY read with fixed launch phase, normal/nasty priority, four-plane, ROM-read and no-start controls.

outcomes.cadence-dependent error: Inspect custom-read sampling and handback rather than globally delaying blitter completion.
